description: Set the legal basis and the processing purposes of a lead or contact (Art. 6 GDPR). The purposes matter: a basis only ever covers the purposes recorded with it, so 'vertrag' with purposes ['rechnung'] does NOT permit cold outreach. NULL basis means 'never established' — a defect in the data, not a No from the person, and the send gate treats the two differently. Optional retention_review_at: a date at which a HUMAN should look again. It deletes nothing and triggers nothing (see run_retention_reviews).

note.description: Why this basis. Shows up in the audit trail.

processing_purposes.description: The purposes this basis covers. Suggested: akquise, bestandskunde, newsletter, terminabstimmung, vertrag, rechnung.

retention_review_at.description: ISO date for a human review.

name: set_legal_basis
